programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by airand sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance.After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance.After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 11 is here and we’re kicking things off where every Florida Keys adventure begins: Key Largo. In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The next stop on our Florida Keys adventure brings Rush Maltz to the legendary waters of Islamorada — a destination known for its laid-back island vibe, world-class fishing, fine dining, and easy access to the reef. Joining locals Jimmy Hendrix and Jordi Hortensi, the game plan is simple: check in by boat, chase fish, eat well, and go dive. From kite fishing the reef to fresh seafood and great company, this episode is all about experiencing the true rhythm of a Florida Keys vacation.

programme.title: Chris Voth
programme.desc: Chris Voth is an accomplished comedian, a licensed teacher, and a published author. Voth made his debut late-night television appearance on the Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson. He also appeared in three seasons of NBC's Last Comic Standing and was chosen for the prestigious Great American Comedy Festival. A 15-year comedy veteran, Voth is a past winner of the Denver Comedy Works Competition and has worked with everyone from Dave Chappelle to Larry the Cable Guy to Linda Ronstadt. Voth's first comedy CD titled "Never Mind the Jim J Bullocks, Here's the Chris Voth" is currently available for purchase. Chris currently balances his performance schedule with his full-time high-school teaching career. You can read his short story, "Stand Up and Deliver," published in the Cream City Review Literary Journal. In it, Chris shares the experiences he had when entering the teaching field after years in stand-up comedy.

He has performed at comedy festivals all over the country including the Boston Comedy Festival, Big Sky Comedy Festival, and the Seattle International Comedy Competition. He was named “Best of Fest” at the Golden Spike Comedy Festival and is the winner of the Finger Lakes Comedy Festival in Ithaca, NY. In 2016, Alex was voted “Best Comedian” by City Weekly Magazine. His debut comedy special “Alex Velluto: Spurious” is currently streaming on Amazon.com.

programme.title: Reencuentros
programme.desc: Al morir su hermano de leucemia, un niño pobre toma su bicicleta y emprende un viaje a la ciudad en busca de su padre.

programme.title: Bello amanecer
programme.desc: La espectacular belleza de una isleña que despierta entre los pescadores las más ardientes y locas pasiones.

programme.title: Señoritas a Disgusto
programme.desc: Tres mujeres que viven en un pueblo lleno de solteronas alquilan una de sus habitaciones a un apuesto hombre.

programme.title: Impaciencia del corazón
programme.desc: Un capitán herido es llevado a un pequeño pueblo y una joven lo cuida. Al final dos mujeres se enamoran de él.

programme.title: Lázaro Cárdenas
programme.desc: En el pueblo de Palmira, Carranza, se instruye a los niños de las escuelas sobre la labor que el general Cárdenas realizó en México.

programme.title: Las figuras de arena
programme.desc: Un joven acompaña a su padre a un pequeño pueblo y se enamora de una bella joven, sin saber que ella es una prostituta.

programme.title: La trenza
programme.desc: Un pueblo confundido por la religión, persigue a una mujer que robó la trenza de la estatua de la Virgen.

programme.title: Más negro que la noche
programme.desc: Tres hermosas mujeres se trasladan a una vieja casona, heredada por la tía de una de ellas, y presencian cosas extrañas.

programme.title: El extensionista
programme.desc: Un ingeniero va a enseñar a los campesinos a mejorar sus cultivos y descubre la gran opresión del cacique del pueblo.

programme.title: Hasta el viento tiene miedo
programme.desc: Un espíritu vengativo se apodera de una joven suicida en un centro de tratamientos. Sucesos misteriosos del pasado atormentan el presente.

programme.title: Cuentos colorados
programme.desc: Las aventuras ocurren en una casa de citas muy lujosa, pero el dueño no lo confiesa su profesión a su tía.

programme.title: Escape Sangriento
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de sus cómplices, un narcotraficante planea un peligroso escape de prisión.

programme.title: Mi nombre es Gatillo
programme.desc: Un hombre llamado el "Gatillo" solo tiene violencia en su sangre y su vida está controlada por las armas.

programme.title: El cachas de oro
programme.desc: Un conocido juez persigue a unos violadores y asesinos, hijos de Ramsés, y los mete a la cárcel, pero su padre los libera, por lo que el valiente juez se ve obligado a matarlos. Ramsés se vengará del juez matando a su prometida.

programme.title: Muertes anunciadas
programme.desc: Un niño busca venganza por la muerte brutal de toda su familia, a manos de una banda de asesinos.

programme.title: Mujer de Cabaret
programme.desc: La hermosa y popular cantante de un club nocturno es condenada injustamente por un asesinato.

programme.title: Pasiones Infernales
programme.desc: Una mujer es maltratada por las mujeres de su aldea por el solo hecho de ser de color.

programme.title: El Payo: un hombre contra el mundo
programme.desc: El Payo protege a su familia del bajo mundo del crimen, el cual quiere robarle su vida y su integridad.

programme.title: Condenados a Duelo
programme.desc: Dos hombres no se detendrán ante nada hasta cobrar venganza con la sangre del culpable.

programme.title: Luna de miel para nueve
programme.desc: Una pareja va a pasar su luna de miel en una cabaña y son invadidos por unos excursionistas que forman nuevas parejas.

programme.title: Bendito entre las mujeres
programme.desc: La historia de dos primos que ignoraban su existencia hasta que su tía Paloma los nombra sus herederos.

programme.title: Encrucijada
programme.desc: El cacique de una región ama a una joven que no le corresponde, e intenta alejar a todo aquel que se acerque a ella.

programme.title: Rayito de Luna
programme.desc: Un joven buceador halla un banco de madreperlas, su padre le da dinero para que compre un velero y saque el tesoro.

programme.title: Adiós Juventud
programme.desc: Al terminar sus estudios, un estudiante de medicina deja a su enamorada quien lo había mantenido durante años.

programme.title: Los Gavilanes Negros
programme.desc: Tres enmascarados negros toman la justicia por su propia mano y protegen a un pueblo dominado por un cacique.

programme.title: Cuánto vale tu hijo
programme.desc: Un niño es atropellado por un auto al salir de la escuela y el conductor ofrece dinero a su familia, quien lo rechaza.

programme.title: Si leyeras mi carta
programme.desc: Una casa guarda un gran secreto sobre una misteriosa mujer. Un hombre extraño dice conocer a Leonora y se empeña en buscarla.

programme.title: Qué Noche Aquella
programme.desc: Una mujer de economía arruinada quiere casar a su bella hija con un tímido capitán, pero este aburre a la joven.

programme.title: Ladrón que roba a ladrón
programme.desc: Un bandido es herido durante un atraco y su cómplice obliga a un médico a curarlo, luego se esconden en un pueblo.

programme.title: Mujeres del Paraíso
programme.desc: Un médico siente compasión por la joven ciega que vio desnuda en el río y junto con un colega decide operarla.

programme.title: Casa de vecindad
programme.desc: En una vecindad varias personas tienen relaciones extramaritales y se desencadenan chismes entre todas las familias.

programme.title: La familia y uno más
programme.desc: Un padre de familia con 16 hijos hace frente a los conflictos, alegrías y los infortunios de una gran familia.

programme.title: Fugitivos
programme.desc: Cuatro sentenciados a muerte se fugan a un pueblo abandonado, juntos liberan presos para poblar con ellos el lugar.

programme.title: El Jinete Negro
programme.desc: Un jinete enmascarado se enfrenta a los criminales más peligrosos de la región.

programme.title: La Sombra en defensa de la juventud
programme.desc: El luchador enmascarado 'La Sombra' se preocupa por los jóvenes y por ello se enfrenta a la delincuencia organizada.

programme.title: Domingo salvaje
programme.desc: Un jubilado a quien sus padres no quieren queda accidentalmente desnudo fuera de su casa y un niño por correr a verlo se accidenta. Esto hace que el jubilado y la madre del niño se acerquen.

programme.title: Tres citas con el destino
programme.desc: El misterio de un hermoso anillo, joya maldita que causó tragedia y muerte a quienes lo tuvieron en sus manos.

programme.title: Hasta que llovió en Sayula
programme.desc: Cuando dos rancheros piden alargar el plazo para pagar una deuda y salvar su rancho, uno de ellos gana la lotería.

programme.title: El Señor Tormenta
programme.desc: Las intrigas que se viven dentro del mundo de la lucha libre mexicana.

programme.title: The Darwinian Revolution
programme.desc: A young Darwin's intention to join the ministry is interrupted by an offer to travel around the world as a naturalist aboard HMS Beagle; the experience changes his life, giving him a growing conviction that species have altered over time.

programme.title: The Darwinian Revolution
programme.sub-title: What's in On the Origin of Species?
programme.desc: Darwin spends two decades developing his theory of evolution; how he is rushed to publish prematurely by the independent discovery of the same principle by Alfred Russel Wallace; "On the Origin of Species" is a masterful statement of his idea.

programme.title: Solving for Zero: The Search for Climate Innovation
programme.desc: Overall warming trends have started to impact the Earth's climate; explaining the background science on how humans arrived at their current climate challenge.

programme.title: Solving for Zero: The Search for Climate Innovation
programme.desc: Exploring difficulties involved in decarbonizing five key sectors that are the major sources of greenhouse gas emissions; considering the difficulty of reducing the cost of clean technologies to be as cheap as those that are used today.

programme.title: Solving for Zero: The Search for Climate Innovation
programme.desc: Taking a look at nuclear batteries that are radically different and smaller than power plants, innovative carbon-capture solutions, and more.

programme.title: Solving for Zero: The Search for Climate Innovation
programme.desc: Innovators discuss key breakthroughs in cement and steel production; learning why reducing the green premiums associated with them can be another essential tool.

programme.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400
programme.desc: Differences between economic history and a history of economics; the primary concerns of current economic historians; watershed economic moments of the last 500 years; why modern economic history begins around 1400.

programme.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400
programme.sub-title: Marco Polo, China, and the Silk Road Trade
programme.desc: Examining the state of the global economy circa 1400, when Europe was at the bottom of the economic success ladder; the broad economic outlines of China, India, and the Islamic world; how Europe laid groundwork for the new capitalist world system.

programme.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400
programme.desc: How Europe's manorial societies helped develop the structures and institutions that would lead to the medieval commercial revolution; what daily life was like on a manor; medieval trade fairs; how wool-cloth production redefined northwestern Europe.

programme.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400
programme.sub-title: How Black Death Reshaped Town and Field
programme.desc: Examining how the Black Death shut down trade routes, lowered economic productivity, disrupted supply and demand, depressed land value and ultimately made the medieval feudal system untenable.

programme.title: Introduction to Paleontology
programme.desc: Learning how much the scientific name of an animal, past or present, really matters; from Carl Linnaeus' Systema Naturae to the modern system of cladistics, exploring how much can be learned about the history of life on Earth through classification.

programme.title: Introduction to Paleontology
programme.desc: Paleontology offers a lens to view how the planet's 4,400 minerals develop over years, both influencing and being influenced by the evolving biosphere; learning how Earth's few primordial minerals interact with liquid water; studying photosynthesis.

programme.title: Introduction to Paleontology
programme.desc: The planet's fossil record reveals that the natural cycles have evolved; learning how biostratigraphy, sclerochronology, carbon-14 dating and other tools reveal a historic Earth with a day as short as six hours and a year as long as 455 days.

programme.title: Introduction to Paleontology
programme.desc: Learning why life on Earth is exactly where it is today; understanding why some species are found only in isolated pockets while others are spread across multiple continents; uncovering what fossils tell us about our planet's historic migrations.

programme.title: The Darwinian Revolution
programme.sub-title: Theories of Evolution Just Before Darwin
programme.desc: The idea of evolution is in the air; looking at precursors to Darwin, including Jean-Baptiste Lamarck; Lamarck writes a systematic account of the evolution of species over time; he proposes that acquired characteristics can be inherited.

programme.title: The Darwinian Revolution
programme.sub-title: Why Evolution Was Rejected Before Darwin
programme.desc: Investigating the dubious status of evolutionary ideas in the years before Darwin's book; one objection is that evolution challenges the Bible and lacks convincing empirical support; some critics even class evolution with fringe ideas.

programme.title: The Darwinian Revolution
programme.desc: A young Darwin's intention to join the ministry is interrupted by an offer to travel around the world as a naturalist aboard HMS Beagle; the experience changes his life, giving him a growing conviction that species have altered over time.

programme.title: The Darwinian Revolution
programme.sub-title: What's in On the Origin of Species?
programme.desc: Darwin spends two decades developing his theory of evolution; how he is rushed to publish prematurely by the independent discovery of the same principle by Alfred Russel Wallace; "On the Origin of Species" is a masterful statement of his idea.

programme.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City
programme.desc: When most people hear the name of the archeological site of Pompeii, they think of destruction; gaining an overview of the course; considering why the remains of Pompeii offer more than just a story of a cataclysm.

programme.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City
programme.sub-title: Geology and Geography On the Bay of Naples
programme.desc: Land and humankind help to shape Pompeii; examining the violent geological forces that forge the distinctive region of the Bay of Naples; tracing its influence on the surrounding geography; the various cultures that contribute to life in this area.

programme.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City
programme.desc: Archeological finds from the area are unearthed starting around 1594; uncovering the history of Pompeii's excavation in the 1700s, from the kings who plunder its artwork to the modern scholars who seek another kind of treasure.

programme.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City
programme.desc: While the last days of Pompeii attract popular attention, the city is a thriving cultural center centuries before its destruction; delving deep into Pompeii's remote Etruscan history; exploring what life is like in this ancient pre-Roman settlement.

programme.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City
programme.desc: Centuries after the establishment of Etruscan Pompeii, the city is invaded by the Samnites; witnessing the conquest of the city by these invaders; considering how Pompeii is redefined and expanded by its new inhabitants.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Ireland and Northern Ireland
